title: Backrooms: Horror
description: A horror-focused Minecraft modpack inspired by the atmosphere of the Backrooms.
body:
Explore endless, empty rooms filled with unsettling silence, dim lighting, and unknown threats. This pack is designed to create constant tension through ambient sounds, darker environments, and dangerous entities lurking in the halls.

• Backrooms-inspired world generation
• Horror atmosphere and ambient sounds
• Hostile entities and survival focus
• Minimal UI for immersion
• Performance optimized
